name: uart_events
title: UART Event-Driven Receive with Echo
description: UART event-driven receive example using the ESP-IDF UART driver with an event queue. Receives data asynchronously, echoes it back, supports a 'reset' command, and includes an LED heartbeat task. Demonstrates task-based UART handling with ring buffer and overflow recovery. NOT validated on hardware.
validation_note: DEPRECATED and NOT validated. The ESP-IDF route was abandoned (installation blocked, never got to hardware). Kept for reference only — do not install or call it.
